About me

Intro

Hey, I'm Shivasai. An aspiring full stack developer from Warangal, Telangana, learning to build scalable web applications end to end. I'm working through the NxtWave CCBP 4.0 Academy while studying at Vaagdevi College of Engineering — from responsive layouts in HTML, CSS and Bootstrap to interactive apps in JavaScript and React.js, with Node.js, Python and SQL powering what happens behind the screen.
